# Libraries


```{r load_packages}
library(curatedTCGAData)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(MOFA2)
```



# Read Colon Cancer assay with curatedTCGA

```{r load_rnaseq}
#------------------------------------------
# 1. Load COAD RNASeq assay
#------------------------------------------
coad_mae_all <- curatedTCGAData(
  diseaseCode = "COAD",
  assays = "*",
  version = "2.1.1",
  dry.run = FALSE
)

assays_subset <- c("COAD_RNASeq2GeneNorm-20160128", "COAD_RPPAArray-20160128")
coad_mae <- coad_mae_all[,, which(names(coad_mae_all) %in% assays_subset)]

# Standardize patient IDs for all assays
updated_coad_mae <- vector("list", length(coad_mae))
names(updated_coad_mae) <- names(coad_mae)
for (i in seq_along(coad_mae)) {
  mae <- coad_mae[[i]]
  patients <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(mae), "-"), function(x) paste(x[1:3], collapse = "-"))
  # Remove suffixes to match clinical data format
  patients <- gsub("\\..*", "", patients)
  colnames(mae) <- make.unique(patients)
  updated_coad_mae[[i]] <- mae
}

# Remove duplicate patients from assays (keep first occurrence)
for (i in seq_along(updated_coad_mae)) {
  mae <- updated_coad_mae[[i]]
  dup_cols <- duplicated(colnames(mae))
  if (any(dup_cols)) {
    updated_coad_mae[[i]] <- mae[, !dup_cols, drop = FALSE]
    print(paste("Removed", sum(dup_cols), "duplicate patients from", names(updated_coad_mae)[i]))
  }
}
```


# Prep embedding
```{r}
#------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare embedding layers
#------------------------------------------
prepare_layer <- function(mat) {
  rownames(mat) <- rownames(mat) %||% paste0("patient_", seq_len(nrow(mat)))
  mat_unique <- mat[!duplicated(rownames(mat)), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Standardize patient IDs and REMOVE SUFFIXES
  embedding_patients <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(mat_unique), "-"), function(x) paste(x[1:3], collapse = "-"))
  embedding_patients <- gsub("\\..*", "", embedding_patients)
  rownames(mat_unique) <- embedding_patients
  
  mat_unique
}

structure_last_prepped <- prepare_layer(structure_last)
```


# Prep clinical metadata
```{r}
#------------------------------------------
# 3. Prepare clinical metadata
#------------------------------------------
prepare_clinical <- function(mae) {
  clinical <- colData(mae)
  completeness <- colSums(!is.na(clinical)) / nrow(clinical) * 100
  clinical_sub <- clinical[, which(completeness > 95), drop = FALSE] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(-matches("aliquot"), -matches("portion"))
  
  # Set row names to patientID column
  if ("patientID" %in% colnames(clinical_sub)) {
    rownames(clinical_sub) <- clinical_sub$patientID
  }
  
  # Factorize categorical variables with 2-10 levels
  numLv <- apply(clinical_sub, 2, function(x) length(unique(x)))
  slideAttrNames <- names(numLv[numLv >= 2 & numLv <= 10])
  for (slideAttrName in slideAttrNames) {
    clinical_sub[[slideAttrName]] <- as.factor(clinical_sub[[slideAttrName]])
  }
  
  clinical_sub
}

metadata_df <- prepare_clinical(coad_mae)

```

# Make embedding SE

```{r}
#------------------------------------------
# 4. Create embedding SE
#------------------------------------------
make_embedding_se <- function(embedding_matrix, metadata_df) {
  # Find patients present in both embedding matrix and clinical metadata
  patients_with_image <- intersect(rownames(embedding_matrix), rownames(metadata_df))
  
  print(paste("Number of common patients:", length(patients_with_image)))
  
  if (length(patients_with_image) == 0) {
    stop("No common patients found between embedding matrix and clinical metadata")
  }
  
  # Subset both to common patients
  embedding_se_coldata <- metadata_df[patients_with_image, , drop = FALSE]
  embedding_se_subset <- embedding_matrix[patients_with_image, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Create assay matrix with proper column names
  assay_matrix <- t(embedding_se_subset)
  colnames(assay_matrix) <- patients_with_image
  
  # Create SummarizedExperiment
  se <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(embedding = assay_matrix),
    colData = embedding_se_coldata
  )
  rownames(se) <- paste0("dim_", seq_len(nrow(se)))
  se
}

embedding_se_last <- make_embedding_se(structure_last_prepped, metadata_df)


```



# Create MAE


```{r}
# common patients
common_final <- intersect(colnames(updated_coad_mae[["COAD_RNASeq2GeneNorm-20160128"]]), 
                         colnames(embedding_se_last))
common_final <- intersect(common_final, rownames(metadata_df))

# create MAE
crc_mae <- MultiAssayExperiment(
  experiments = list(
    RNASeq = updated_coad_mae[["COAD_RNASeq2GeneNorm-20160128"]],
    Embedding_last = embedding_se_last
  ),
  colData = metadata_df
)

```


# Run MOFA

```{r run_mofa}

run_mofa_pipeline <- function(mae, num_factors = 15, seed = 42, outfile = NULL) {
  mofa_obj <- create_mofa_from_MultiAssayExperiment(mae)
  
  model_opts <- get_default_model_options(mofa_obj)
  model_opts$num_factors <- num_factors
  
  train_opts <- get_default_training_options(mofa_obj)
  train_opts$convergence_mode <- "slow"
  train_opts$seed <- seed
  
  mofa_obj <- prepare_mofa(mofa_obj, model_opts, train_opts)
  mofa_obj.trained <- run_mofa(mofa_obj, outfile = outfile, use_basilisk = TRUE)
  mofa_obj.trained
}

```
